source_role: train.jsonl only; one lowest-id valid QA per distinct article/passsage
model: existing Qwen learner with fixed LoRA checkpoints; no new training
primary_loss: 1-token-F1 under official SQuAD-style normalization; maximum over annotated answers
nu: uniform four frozen content-preserving prompt formats, exactly enumerated
source_eligibility: Deduplicate article ID and normalized passage hash; exclude every original SQuAD train/dev and known retrieval context hash; all four complete chat prompts <=1024 tokens; at least one valid exact-span answer of 1..30 tokens; query contains exactly one @placeholder; no model-dependent filtering
query_instruction: Read the passage and fill @placeholder in the query. Return only the exact entity span from the passage, without explanation.
selection: smallest negative bound, factual fallback; one immutable decision per method before opening test predictions
target: Uniform finite eligible article catalog; conditional chi-square shifts over four prompt formats. Random disjoint simple-random-without-replacement role blocks. Bounds use the WOR bounded-MGF comparison, not an unjustified IID variance certificate.
test_rule: Evaluate all frozen candidates on sealed test only after immutable decisions; report all signs and factual fallback. No rerun or tuning after results.
feasibility_gate: Require >=17000 eligible unseen distinct passages/articles and fixed checkpoint hashes before any outcome. If unavailable, record blocker without choosing a different benchmark or changing eligibility.
semantics: Conditional on benchmark gold answers and text-preserving format edits. No claim of absence from unknown foundation-model pretraining.
